mn148:9.3: Cakkhuñ ca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṃgati phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā;
mn148:9.4: sotañ ca paṭicca sadde ca uppajjati sotaviññāṇaṃ;
mn148:9.5: ghānañ ca paṭicca gandhe ca uppajjati ghānaviññāṇaṃ;
mn148:9.6: jivhañ ca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇaṃ;
mn148:9.7: kāyañ ca paṭicca phoṭṭhabbe ca uppajjati kāyaviññāṇaṃ;
mn148:9.8: manañ ca paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṃgati phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā.
mn148:9.10: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ,
mn148:10.1: Cakkhuṃ attā ti yo vadeyya, taṃ na uppajjati.
mn148:10.2: Cakkhussa uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati.
mn148:10.3: Yassa kho pana uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati, Attā me uppajjati ca veti cāti icc' assa evam āgataṃ hoti;
mn148:10.7: Rūpā attā ti yo vadeyya, taṃ na uppajjati.
mn148:10.8: Rūpānaṃ uppādo pi vayo pi uppajjati.
mn148:10.9: Yassa kho pana uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati, Attā me uppajjati ca veti cāti icc' assa evam āgataṃ hoti;
mn148:10.13: Cakkhuviññānaṃ attā ti yo vadeyya, taṃ na uppajjati.
mn148:10.14: Cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati.
mn148:10.15: Yassa kho pana uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati, Attā me uppajjati ca veti cāti icc' assa evam āgataṃ hoti;
mn148:10.18: iti cakkhuṃ anattā rūpā anattā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattā.
mn148:10.19: Cakkhusamphasso attā ti yo vadeyya, taṃ na uppajjati.
mn148:10.20: Cakkhusamphassassa uppādo pi vāyo pi paññāyati.
mn148:10.21: Yassa kho pana uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati, Attā me uppajjati ca veti cāti icc' assa evam āgataṃ hoti;
mn148:10.24: iti cakkhuṃ anattā rūpā anattā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattā cakkhusamphasso anattā.
mn148:10.25: Vedanā attā ti yo vadeyya, taṃ na uppajjati.
mn148:10.26: Vedanāya uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati.
mn148:10.27: Yassa kho pana uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati, Attā me uppajjati ca veti cāti icc' assa evam āgataṃ hoti;
mn148:10.30: iti cakkhuṃ anattā rūpā anattā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattā cakkhusamphasso anattā vedanā anattā.
mn148:10.31: Taṇhā attā ti yo vadeyya, taṃ na uppajjati.
mn148:10.32: Taṇhāya uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati.
mn148:10.33: Yassa kho pana uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati, Attā me uppajjati ca veti cāti icc' assa evam āgataṃ hoti;
mn148:10.36: iti cakkhuṃ anattā rūpā anattā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattā cakkhusamphasso anattā vedanā anattā taṇhā anattā.
mn148:11.5: Mano attā ti yo vadeyya, taṃ na uppajjati.
mn148:11.6: Manassa uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati.
mn148:11.7: Yassa kho pana uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati, Atta me uppajjati ca veti cāti icc' assa evaṃ āgataṃ hoti;

mn148:12.2: Dhammassa uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati.
mn148:12.3: Yassa kho pana uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati. Attā me uppajjati ca veti cāti icc' assa evam āgataṃ hoti;

mn148:13.3: Yassa kho pana uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati, Attā me uppajjati ca veti cāti icc' assa evam āgataṃ hoti;
mn148:13.6: iti mano anattā dhammā anattā manoviññaṇaṃ anattā.
mn148:14.1: Manosamphasso attā ti yo vadeyya, taṃ na uppajjati.
mn148:14.2: Manosamphassassa uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati.
mn148:14.3: Yassa kho pana uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati, Attā me uppajjati ca veti cāti icc' assa evam āgataṃ hoti;

mn148:15.1: Vedanā attā ti yo vadeyya, taṃ na uppajjati.
mn148:15.2: Vedanāya uppādo pi vayo pi paññāyati.
mn148:15.3: Yassa kho pana . . . veti cāti iccassa evam āgataṃ hoti;

mn148:15.7: Taṇhā anattā ti yo vadeyya, taṃ na uppajjati.
mn148:15.12: iti mano anattā dhammā anattā manoviññāṇaṃ anattā manosamphasso anattā vedanā anattā taṇhā anattā.
mn148:16.1: Ayaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, sakkāyasamudayagāminī paṭipadā:--
mn148:16.2: Cakkhuṃ: Etaṃ mama eso 'ham asmi eso me attā ti samanupassati.
mn148:17-21.1: Rūpe: Etaṃ mama . . . attā ti samanupassati.
mn148:17-21.2: Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ: Etaṃ mama . . . attā ti samanupassati.
mn148:17-21.3: Cakkhusamphassaṃ: Etaṃ mama . . . attā ti samanupassati.
mn148:17-21.4: Vedanaṃ: Etaṃ mama . . . attā ti samanupassati.
mn148:17-21.5: Taṇhaṃ: Etaṃ mama . . . attā ti samanupassati.
mn148:17-21.10: Manaṃ: Etaṃ mama . . . attā ti samanupassati; Dhamme: Etaṃ mama . . . attā ti samanupassati; Manoviññāṇaṃ: Etaṃ mama . . . attā ti samanupassati; Manosamphassaṃ: Etaṃ mama . . . samanupassati; Vedanam: Etaṃ mama . . . attā ti samanupassati; Taṇhaṃ: Etaṃ mama . . . attā ti samanupassati.
mn148:22.1: Ayaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā:--
mn148:22.2: Cakkhuṃ: N' etaṃ mama n' eso 'ham asmi na me so attā ti samanupassati;
mn148:23-27.1: rūpe: N' etaṃ . . . attā ti samanupassati;
mn148:28.1: Cakkhuñ ca, bhikkhave, paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṃgati phasso; phassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā. So sukhānaṃ vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati; tassa rāgānusayo anuseti. Dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati; tassa paṭighānusayo anuseti. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno tassā vedanāya samudayañ ca atthaṅgamañ ca assādañ ca ādīnavañ ca nissaraṇañ ca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti; tassa avijjānusayo anuseti. So vata, bhikkhave, sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayaṃ appahāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayaṃ appaṭivinodetvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayaṃ asamūhanitvā avijjaṃ appahāya vijjaṃ anuppādetvā diṭṭhe va dhamme dukkhass' antakaro bhavissatīti n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. Sotañ ca, bhikkhave, paṭicca sadde ca uppajjati sotaviññāṇaṃ. Ghānañ ca, bhikkhave, paṭicca gandhe ca . . . &c. to . . . manañ ca, bhikkhave, paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṃgati phasso; phassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ. vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā.
mn148:28.2: So sukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati;
mn148:28.4: Dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati;
mn148:28.6: Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno tassā vedanāya samudayañ ca atthaṅgamañ ca assādañ ca ādīnavañ ca nissaraṇañ ca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti;
mn148:28.8: So vata, bhikkhave, sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayaṃ appahāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayaṃ appaṭivinodetvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayaṃ asamūhanitvā avijjaṃ appahāya vijjaṃ anuppādetvā diṭṭhe va dhamme dukkhass' antakaro bhavissatīti n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn148:34.1: bhikkhave, paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saṃgati phasso phassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā adukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā.
mn148:34.2: So sukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati;
mn148:34.4: Dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷiṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati;
mn148:34.6: Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno tassā vedanāya samudayañ ca atthaṅgamañ ca assādañ ca ādīnavañ ca nissaraṇañ ca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti;
mn148:34.8: So vata, bhikkhave, sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayaṃ pahāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭhe va dhamme dukkhassa antakaro bhavissatīti, ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati.
mn148:35.1: Sotañ ca, bhikkhave, paṭicca sadde ca uppajjati sotaviññāṇaṃ;
mn148:36.1: ghānañ ca, bhikkhave, paṭicca gandhe ca uppajjati gandhaviññāṇaṃ;
mn148:37.1: jivhañ ca, bhikkhave, paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇaṃ;
mn148:38.1: kāyañ ca, bhikkhave, paṭicca phoṭṭhabbe ca uppajjati kāyaviññāṇaṃ;
mn148:39.1: manañ ca, bhikkhave, paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṃgati phasso, phassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā.
mn148:39.2: So sukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati;
mn148:40.1: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃ nibbindati rūpesu nibbindati cakkhuviññāṇe nibbindati cakkhusamphasse nibbindati vedanāya nibbindati taṇhāya nibbindati.
mn148:41.5: manasmiṃ nibbindati dhammesu nibbindati manoviññāṇe nibbindati manosamphasse nibbindati vedanāya nibbindati taṇhāya nibbindati.
mn148:41.6: Nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam iti ñāṇaṃ hoti:
mn148:41.7: Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
mn148:41.9: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun ti.
mn148:41.10: Imasmiṃ kho pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsūti. 149.
